name: SLOOP
description: A live groovebox: tracks, layers, a step sequencer, song mode, punch-in effects and samples, played on the FM-1 in real time.

name: Felucca
description: The custom firmware the others build on: the FM-1's own synth engines, a sequencer, effects and a better panel, with an editor in the browser.

name: FM1 Stock
description: M-VAVE's factory firmware for the FM-1: eight voices sharing twenty notes of polyphony, each with its own sound, MIDI channel, level, pan and fine tune, a 64-step sequencer with per-step ratchets and an 8-track by 8-section pattern arranger, and 128 shared FX chains under MIDI control.

name: FM1 Open
description: M-VAVE's open-source firmware and SDK for the FM-1: eight tracks, eight sample slots, a 128-voice DX7 library with SysEx import and export, step recording, PLAY track roles that keep their sound across project changes, tap tempo with a synchronized delay and full MIDI routing, plus a browser workbench.

name: ChoralRoot
description: A Telepathic Orchid-style chord instrument: one hand plays roots, the other shapes chords; voicings, performance modes, bass and a looper.

name: DUB-1
description: A generative dub techno machine that plays itself from the moment it is on: chord stabs into a tape echo, FM pings, a sub bass on five grooves, a ducking kick, crackle, and an eight-bar arrangement with breaks and fills.

name: JIANT FM
description: A bio-synthetic groovebox: six tracks drawn as living beings in thermal colours, eight engines (FM6 with Dexed, analog, phase, voice…), mutating macros, song mode from SLOOP. Not yet tested much on a real FM-1.

name: FM-1+VA
description: A live-performance rebuild of the FM-1: a Virtual Analog engine with seven-oscillator super stacks, drift and zero-delay-feedback filters, an 8-bit chiptune engine with drums, sound effects and 31-shape arpeggios, a 64-step sequencer with per-step ratchet, chance, gate and parameter locks, patterns chained into songs, and four knobs on every screen.

name: 386DX
description: A karaoke robot with a band: it sings songs from karaoke and MIDI files, or lines you type, to the notes you play. Its face is the voice. Keys, bass and drums play along, with a step sequencer and sixteen punch-in effects.

name: Fart Machine One
description: A questionable musical instrument: ten artisanal farts, reverb, delay and a sixteen-step sequencer.

name: MIN-1
description: A tiny minimalist ensemble after Philip Glass: it starts playing when you switch on, you join whenever you like. In EASY mode every white key is a chord that fits. Four models, twenty pieces.

name: Rainbow Mode
description: A music toy for little children: 63 cartoon friends, every key in tune, chords, strumming, songs to follow and an ear game, notes on a staff, a volume cap for small ears.

name: HYP-1
description: Hypnotic techno and acid: a breathing pad, a deep drone, a generative 303 line and grain over drums you sequence. Flip patterns on the bar, break it down, build it up. Forked from AMB-1. One of a pack of four: LOF-1 (a lofi groovebox), ECO-1 (a plant plays it) and GRAV-1 (a star and its planets), experimental, on its project page.

name: LOF-1
description: A lofi groovebox: you play the lead and a tired jazz band follows, comp, bass and drums moving with your chords, an Answer voice replying, a record, cassette, reel or radio playing underneath. Part of the RedtailWorks pack with HYP-1.

name: ECO-1
description: A plant plays it: three leaves fire notes as light and water charge them, a stem drones beneath, and rain, wind, gusts and the passing day and night play the plant. Eight plants, each in its own place. Part of the RedtailWorks pack with HYP-1.

name: GRAV-1
description: A star and its planets: slow, dark, spacey ambient, a star of coloured noise with up to six planets, each a voice playing around its orbit. Bigger planets swell smaller ones; dust, asteroids and comets drift through. Part of the RedtailWorks pack with HYP-1.

name: CTY-1
description: A city grows and plays: each power-on grows a new town on new land, forest, desert, alpine, volcano isles, plains, beach or river, into a huge city where every car, building, storm and disaster is a note, each land with its own sound. Part of the RedtailWorks pack with HYP-1.

name: DRIFT
description: An ambient instrument for live sessions: warm synths, spacious pads and delicate plucks over a generative Euclidean sequencer on one track, with delays and reverbs from spring to shimmer. Built on Felucca.
